channel.title: The Co-operative Group - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Co-operative Group (thenews.coop)

item.title: Luxembourg parliament calls on government to support housing co-ops
item.description: Luxembourg's legislature has unanimously adopted a motion calling on ministers to develop a national framework for housing co-operatives

item.title: Guide launched for Australian community energy sector
item.description: Community Power Agency, an independent advisor to the energy co-op sector, has released a guide to developing community energy

item.title: Co-op lessons from a pupose-led ice cream business
item.description: The Co-op Retail Conference heard from Ben & Jerry’s Jessie Macneil-Brown about how the organisation turns its purpose into practice

item.title: Co-op Retail Conference: Co-operating in challenging times
item.description: Leading voices from OurCoop, Southern and the Co-op Group discuss a challenging business environment at the Co-op Retail Conference

item.title: Fair finance: How should retail co-ops work with credit unions?
item.description: New partnerships between credit unions and co-op retail societies were discussed at a session on fair finance at the Co-op Retail Conference

item.title: Co-op Group hosts another cash hub to boost financial inclusion
item.description: Co-op Group is hosts Cash Access UK hub at its store in Crowthorne, Berkshire, to provide convenient access to cash and financial services

item.title: Digital innovation: European perspective at the Co-op Retail Conference
item.description: UK Co-op Retail Conference hears from from Italian, Danish, Czech, and Slovak co-ops on ways that digital innovation can drive engagement

item.title: Dairy co-ops Dale Farm and Aurivo enter all-Ireland partnership
item.description: Dairy co-operatives Dale Farm and Aurivo have announced a new strategic covering the whole of the island of Ireland

item.title: Cecop joins calls for supportive EU budget and procurement rules
item.description: Cecop has co-signed two policy calls to the EU, calling for supportive measures in the upcoming budget and procurement legislation

item.title: Credit union apex steps in to support debt awareness campaign
item.description: The Association of British Credit Unions (Abcul) supported Debt Awareness Week (16–22 March), joining a campaign by StepChange Debt Charity
